investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Silveren Credit Union (digital banking); Platform: Microsoft Azure northeurope (zones northeurope-1/northeurope-2/northeurope-3); network range 10.20.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster silver-prod-northe (AKS); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic transfers-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer transfers-api, consumer accounts-api; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
